y-m-17-01.title: Intee ayaan sawiraa 3 km ee khariidada?
y-m-17-01.topic: Cabbirka: saamiga dhererka khariidada iyo dhererka dhabta ah
y-m-17-01.goal: Hel jihada cabbirku ku xidho dhererka khariidada iyo dhererka dhabta ah si aad u hesho qaladka xalka, oo samee dhowr lammaane (dhererka khariidada, cabbirka) oo ku habboon isla dhererka dhabta ah.
y-m-17-01.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad khariidad ku sawirto waddada lugta ee iskuulka hortiisa. Hoosta khariidada, cabbirka '1 : 50000' (hal ilaa konton kun) ayaa lagu qoray. Tani macnaheedu waa 1 cm khariidada waa 50000 cm dhabta ah, khariidada oo dhanna waa loo yareeyay isla saami. 1 km waa 100000 cm. Mina wuxuu u xalliyay 'Imisa cm ayaan khariidada ku sawiraa waddo runtii 3 km ah?' sida hoose.
y-m-17-01.thinking.1: Dooridda hababka lagu hubiyo haddii natiijadu macno leedahay
y-m-17-01.thinking.2: Samaynta dhowr kiis oo buuxiya shuruudaha
y-m-17-01.prereq.0: Ogaanshaha in cabbirka (tusaale 1 : 50000) uu yahay saamiga dhererka khariidada iyo dhererka dhabta ah
y-m-17-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan xalka Mina.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore eeg natiijada. Ma ku habboon tahay in dhererka khariidada lagu sawirayo uu aad uga dheeraado dhererka dhabta ah ee 300000 cm?
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isticmaal macnaha cabbirka, '1 cm khariidada waa 50000 cm dhabta ah,' sida uu yahay, oo isku xigta qor imisa cm dhabta ah ayay yihiin 2 cm iyo 3 cm khariidada.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.1: 1 cm khariidada waa 50000 cm dhabta ah, sidaas darteed (dhererka khariidada) = (dhererka dhabta ah) × 50000.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.2: 300000 × 50000 = 15000000000, sidaas darteed dhererka khariidada waa 15000000000 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed waddada waa in khariidada lagu sawiraa 15000000000 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.explain: Qaladku wuxuu ka bilaabmaa safka 2. Cabbirka 1 : 50000 macnaheedu waa dhererka dhabta ahi waa 50000 jeer dhererka khariidada, sidaas darteed si aad u hesho dhererka khariidada waa inaad u qaybisaa dhererka dhabta ah 50000, ma aha inaad ku dhufato 50000. Xisaabinta safka 3 waxay raacdaa safka 2 sidaas darteed xisaabta laftiisa waa sax laakiin natiijadu waa qariib, safka 4 na wuu khaldan yahay sabab isku mid ah. Haddii si sax ah loo xalliyo, waxaa lagu sawiraa 6 cm khariidada.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.prompt: Hubinta kee ayaa kaa caawisa inaad ogaato natiijada Mina inay qariib tahay? Dooro dhammaan kuwa ku habboon.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, barbar dhig ‘hubintani ma kuu ogolaanaysaa inaad ogaato fikirku inuu khaldan yahay, mise isla fikirka ayay soo celinaysaa?’
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.1: U beddel 15000000000 cm ee Mina helay km, oo ka fikir haddii ay tahay dherer lagu sawiri karo hal khariidad.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.a: Mar kale ku riix isla xisaabta xisaabiye si aad u aragto haddii isla qiimihii hore uu soo baxo
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.a: Haddii aad ku xisaabiso isla fikirka, isla qiimaha ayaa mar kale soo baxa. Xisaabtu inay sax tahay iyo fikirku (isla'egtu) inuu sax yahay waa arrimo kala duwan.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.b: Tirada aad bay u weyn tahay, sidaas darteed qorista cutubka km oo keliya waxay ka dhigtaa qiime sax ah
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.b: Haddii aad cutubka oo keliya beddesho, tirada aad qorto way is beddelaa laakiin dhererku sidiisa ayuu ahaanayaa. 15000000000 cm waa 150000 km, taasoo aad u dheer in lagu sawiro khariidad.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.c: Isku xigta qor imisa cm dhab ah ayay yihiin 1 cm, 2 cm, iyo 3 cm khariidada
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.c: Haddii aad macnaha cabbirka jumlad ku qorto, waxaad arki kartaa jihada weyn.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.d: Isticmaal caqli-fahan si aad u weydiiso haddii dhererka khariidada lagu sawiray uu ka dheeraan karo dhererka dhabta ah
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad hubineysaa haddii natiijadu macno leedahay adigoo isticmaalaya fikradda aasaasiga ah ee ah khariidadu waa sawir yaraaday oo ah wixii dhabta ahaa.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.explain: Haddii aad macnaha cabbirka sida 1 cm → 50000 cm iyo 2 cm → 100000 cm qorto, ama aad natiijada ku eegto caqli-fahanka ah khariidadu waa inay ka yar tahay dhabta, waad ogaan kartaa jihada ku dhufashada inay khaldan tahay. Isla xisaabta mar kale samaynteeda way soo celin kartaa isla qaladka.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.prompt: Markan, adigoo si sax ah u fikiraya, waxaad rabtaa inaad waddo runtii 2 km ah u sawirto sida cm khariidada (tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 4 ilaa 20). Samee laba cabbir '1 : b' oo aad isticmaali karto, oo leh laba dherer oo khariidada ah oo kala duwan.

y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Dhererka khariidada a waa inuu noqdaa tiro dabiici ah oo ka mid ah 4 ilaa 20.

y-m-17-01.s.s3.fail.c3: a cm khariidada ma noqdaan 200000 cm dhab ahaan. Mar kale hubi imisa cm dhab ah ayay yihiin 1 cm khariidada.
y-m-17-01.s.s3.explain: tus. 4 cm waa 1 : 50000, 5 cm waa 1 : 40000, 8 cm waa 1 : 25000, 10 cm na waa 1 : 20000. Xitaa isla 2 km, marka aad khariidada ku sawirto dheer, □ ee cabbirka waa inuu ka yaraado (khariidad ka faahfaahsan).

y-m-17-02.title: Haddii aad isticmaasho laba kuubon, ma la mid yahay dhimis 30%?
y-m-17-02.topic: Boqolleyda: ku dabaqidda heerarka dhimista mid ka dib mid
y-m-17-02.goal: Tijaabi fikradda koowaad ee ku darista heerarka dhimista adigoo isticmaalaya tusaalayaal tirooyin ah, dib u eeg xukunkaaga iyo kalsoonidaada mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub timaaddo, oo sharax halbeegga boqolleyda tilmaamayso.
y-m-17-02.material: Dukaan online ah wuxuu leeyahay laba kuubon. Kuubonka 가 waa '20% oo laga dhimay qiimaha hadda' kuubonka 나 na waa '10% oo laga dhimay qiimaha hadda,' 가 iyo 나 labadaba isku xigta ayaa la isticmaali karaa. Minseo wuxuu yidhi, "20% iyo 10% waa isla 30% dhimis wada jir!" Qiimayaasha liiska dhammaantood waa tirooyin dabiici ah (won) oo ka weyn 0, oo qiimayaasha si sax ah u soo baxa won oo keliya ayaa la isticmaalayaa.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Saddexda qiime ee caadiga ah dhammaantood, qiimaha laba kuuboon waa 72% qiimaha caadiga ah, qiimaha dhimista 30% na waa 70% qiimaha caadiga ah. y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Marka qiimaha caadiga ahi weyn yahay, labada qiime way u sii dhowaadaan
y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: 20000 won, farqigu wuxuu noqday 400 won, taasoo dhab ahaan weynaatay. Naftaada hubi haddii farqigu yaraado.

y-m-17-02.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Labada nidaamba waxay siinayaan 7200 won. Xisaabtan, farqi ku xidhan nidaamka ma jiro.

y-m-17-05.title: Haddii labaduba wada kortaan, ma isku-saamayn toosan baa?
y-m-17-05.topic: Shuruudaha kala saara isku-saameynta toosan iyo isku-saameynta rogan
y-m-17-05.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya qiimayaasha jadwal, ka shaqee haddii laba qadar ay yihiin isku-saameyn toosan, kala sooc 'labaduba way korayaan' iyo 'way korayaan isla tirada jeerarka,' oo sharax malo-awaalka loo baahan yahay marka qadarradu u isbeddelaan siyaabo ka soo horjeeda.
y-m-17-05.material:

 (가) Tirada tufaaxa iyo qiimaha: 1 tufaax 800 won, 2 tufaax 1600 won, 3 tufaax 2400 won (tufaax kasta wuxuu ku kacaa isku mid) 
 (나) Masaafada taksiga lagu socdaalay iyo kharashka: 1 km 3500 won, 2 km 4000 won, 4 km 5000 won (kharashka aasaasiga ah 3000 won oo lagu daray 500 won 1 km kasta) 
 (다) Waqtiga la socday iyo masaafada la socday: 10 daqiiqo 800 m, 20 daqiiqo 1600 m, 30 daqiiqo 2400 m (socod isla xawaare ah adigoon nasan) 
 (라) Tirada shaqaalaha iyo tirada maalmaha lagu dhammeeyo shaqada: 2 qof 12 maalmood, 4 qof 6 maalmood, 6 qof 4 maalmood 
 (마) Da'da iyo dhererka: 6 sano jir 115 cm, 9 sano jir 133 cm, 12 sano jir 150 cm

y-m-17-07.title: Dib u qorista 'kor u kac 5%' ee joornaalka dugsiga
y-m-17-07.topic: Sheegidda isbeddel boqolkiiba si sax ah
y-m-17-07.goal: Sheeg haddii ‘kor u kac 5%’ uu yahay isbeddel saamiga ama isbeddel tirada dadka, oo dib u qor weedhaha adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyin si akhristayaashu u fahmaan si khaldan.
y-m-17-07.material: Joornaalka dugsigu wuxuu daabacay maqaal sidan oo kale ah. y-m-17-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ma sheegi karno. Maxaa yeelay qaabka dhagaxu ma habaysna
y-m-17-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Xitaa haddii aadan ogayn qiimaha saxda ah, waxaad sheegi kartaa cabbirkiisa ugu yar.
y-m-17-10.s.s1.reflect: Haddii aad marka hore doortay ‘way buuxsantaa,’ qor in macluumaadka labaad uu kordhiyay kalsoonida go'aankaas; haddii aad doortay ‘haddii is-dul saaran yihiin, ma ogi,’ qor macluumaadka yareeyay walaacaas. Sidoo kale ka fikir waxa ‘habka helidda’ ku tiirsanaa macluumaadka saddexaad.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiib ayaa yidhi, “Haddii aad farqiga heerka biyaha kahor iyo kadib gelinta dhagaxa ku dhufato ballaca iyo dhererka, waxaad heshaa mugga dhagaxa.” Ma habkan had iyo jeer la isticmaali karaa? Qor goorta la isticmaali karo iyo goorta aan la isticmaali karin.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig qiimaha aad xisaabisay tallaabada dhagaxu qayb keliya biyaha hoostooda ahaa (macluumaadka saddexaad) iyo mugga dhagaxa oo dhan.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir in tallaabada biyuhu buuxsameen oo daadteen (macluumaadka labaad), aad heli karto mugga adigoo cabbiraya heerka biyaha.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.placeholder: tus. Habkan waa la isticmaali karaa marka ... laakiin marka ... wuxuu ...
y-m-17-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay, sida shuruud, in dhagaxu gebi ahaanba biyaha hoostooda yahay?
y-m-17-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka fikirtay sababta aadan u ogaan karin mugga farqiga dhererka marka biyuhu daadanayaan?
y-m-17-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Marka aan la isticmaali karin, ma ka fikirtay in mugga dhabta ahi ka weyn yahay mise ka yar yahay qiimaha laga helay farqiga dhererka?
y-m-17-10.s.s2.model.0: Waa sax kaliya marka dhagaxu gebi ahaanba biyaha hoostooda yahay oo biyuhu aanay daadan. Haddii dhagaxu qayb keliya biyaha hoostooda yahay, biyaha la riixay waa intii qaybta biyaha hoostooda ah, markaa qiimuhu wuxuu ka yar yahay mugga dhabta ah.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.model.1: Haddii biyuhu daadanayaan, ma cabbiri kartid dhererka ay kaceen, haddii dhagaxuna biyaha ka soo baxo, qaybtaasi xisaabta ma gasho. Waa inaad isticmaashaa kaliya marka dhagaxu gebi ahaanba biyaha hoostooda yahay.
y-m-17-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab sheegtay labadaba daadashada iyo in aan biyaha hoostooda la ahayn.
